title: ID0477919-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P7 312547889/04]  Multiple Issue in CCV
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Multiple Issue in CCV
Solution:
Contact the payment provider and they need to set the
TKM Command "OR" to Value "1".
They should know what this TKM command is. After next reboot the terminal should be able to handle partial reconcilations and won't close transactions it shouldn't

additional_info.subject: ID0477919-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P7 312547889/04]  Multiple  Issue in CCV CRM:02888000598
additional_info.body:
Hello Chetouah, good afternoon.
This hotfix did not fix this issue, there was a miscommunication and I believe that this Seita hotfix would fix it.
I have discussed with our development team and the fix is the following:
You need to contact the payment provider and they need to set the
TKM Command "OR" to Value "1".
They should know what this TKM command is. After next reboot the terminal should be able to handle partial reconcilations and won't close transactions it shouldn't.
Let me know when you have requested this to the CCV colleagues, so that I can confirm remotely if it's corrected or not.
Have a nice weekend.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
